related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Primary issue: requests PHP language integration following Java as template, requires ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, and optional extract_inheritance

constraints: tree-sitter-php grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields) for inheritance; no parent_class/base_classes/interfaces fields exist
PHP has no separate trait_declaration node type in tree-sitter-php grammar; traits are not a distinct declaration kind
function_definition is the node kind for standalone functions; method_declaration is for class methods
All language modules must export ELEMENT_QUERY and CALL_QUERY; DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis; other queries optional
LanguageInfo struct requires language: Language field from tree_sitter_<lang>::LANGUAGE; all other fields are optional or have None default
Workspace dependencies in Cargo.toml must use exact versions (e.g., tree-sitter-php = "X.Y.Z") to pass 7-day freshness gate
test_coverage: Existing language modules test: (1) element_query happy path with parse_<lang>() and QueryCursor, (2) extract_inheritance with tree traversal and base class/interface assertions, (3) defuse_query write sites (local_variable_declaration, assignment), (4) defuse_query read sites (identifier @read.usage), (5) augmented assignment (WriteRead), (6) edge cases (empty files, no declarations). No integration tests in mod.rs for language registration itself; registration tested implicitly via get_language_info() and get_ts_language() unit tests.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration, function_definition, method_declaration; inheritance via base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) child nodes; formal_parameters field for function/method signatures
library_findings.notes: Grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as optional child nodes (not fields) on class_declaration; base_clause contains comma-separated names for extends; class_interface_clause contains comma-separated names for implements; no parent_class or interfaces fields; function_definition for standalone functions, method_declaration for class/interface methods; enum_declaration with enum_declaration_list body; anonymous_class for new class {...} expressions

library_findings.relevant_api: Language type, Node, Query, QueryCursor, Parser; Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::parent(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte(); QueryCursor::matches() for query execution
library_findings.notes: Core parsing API used by all language modules; field-based access via child_by_field_name() for named fields; tree traversal via parent() for ancestor walking; byte-range extraction requires bounds check against source.len()

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (CSS-like pattern)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY capturing function_definition and method_declaration, CALL_QUERY for call sites, empty DEFUSE_QUERY (None). Register in mod.rs with minimal LanguageInfo (no extract_inheritance, no handlers). Add php extension to lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml dependencies.
pros: Fastest path to MVP: ~50 LOC in php.rs, minimal registration
Matches CSS/Markdown/YAML pattern for languages without full semantic support
No handler functions needed; no complex tree walking
cons: Limited utility for semantic code analysis tasks
Does not meet issue requirement for DEFUSE_QUERY

approaches.name: Full PHP support with inheritance and def-use (Java-like pattern)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY capturing function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for method_invocation and function_call; DEFUSE_QUERY for local_variable_declaration, assignment_expression, update_expression, identifier @read.usage; extract_inheritance() handler walking base_clause and class_interface_clause child nodes. Register in mod.rs with full LanguageInfo including extract_inheritance. Add php extension to lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Write 9+ test cases covering all declaration kinds, inheritance, and def-use patterns.
pros: Complete semantic support matching Java/Python/Rust patterns
Enables def-use analysis for variable tracking
Consistent with codebase architecture and test coverage expectations
cons: Requires understanding tree-sitter-php grammar quirks (base_clause vs field)
More complex tree walking for inheritance extraction

approaches.name: Full PHP support with optional handlers (Python-like pattern)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY (capturing type names in type hints); extract_inheritance() handler but no extract_function_name/find_method_for_receiver/find_receiver_type (set to None in LanguageInfo). Register in mod.rs with partial handlers. Add php extension to lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php to Cargo.toml. Write 9+ test cases including type reference extraction.
pros: Includes REFERENCE_QUERY for type analysis (PHP has type hints)
Meets issue requirements with moderate complexity
Easier to extend later with method handlers if needed
cons: Partial handler coverage may limit future IDE integration
Type reference extraction in PHP is noisy (dynamic typing)

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with inheritance and def-use, Java-like pattern). Rationale: (1) Issue explicitly requests DEFUSE_QUERY, which Approach 1 omits; (2) PHP's class-based OOP and inheritance patterns map cleanly to Java's model, making the Java template directly applicable; (3) tree-sitter-php grammar is mature and well-documented (High reputation, 156 code snippets in Context7); (4) Full test coverage (9+ cases) aligns with project standards seen in java.rs, python.rs, kotlin.rs; (5) Enables semantic analysis for PHP codebases, justifying the ~300-400 LOC investment; (6) Consistent with codebase's commitment to completeness (all 18 existing languages have DEFUSE_QUERY or explicit None with rationale).

pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,

    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
"
inheritance_walk_citation: From tree-sitter-php grammar (common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json): class_declaration has optional child nodes base_clause (not a field) and class_interface_clause (not a field). To extract inheritance: (1) find class_declaration node; (2) iterate child nodes to find base_clause node (if present); (3) iterate base_clause's named children (comma-separated names) and extract text for each as 'extends <name>'; (4) iterate child nodes to find class_interface_clause node (if present); (5) iterate class_interface_clause's named children and extract text for each as 'implements <name>'. The base_clause and class_interface_clause are sibling nodes within class_declaration, not fields accessed via child_by_field_name().
